text_block_list.text:
One day in the classroom, I noticed Tokai Teio
and the others busy with something.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We're prepping for the upcoming fan event!
We're gonna host a "proper" tea party, you see~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We've been having McQueen and Arden
check our tea party etiquette!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Although Teio-san's manners are already flawless,
so it's mostly just practice for me, ganbaru...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishi-shi♪ Well, of course!
There's nothing the great Teio-sama can't do~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Teio-san...!
I must quickly learn to entertain our guests
with complete confidence too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Could you play the role of our guest?
Atmosphere is super important for this kind of thing!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, I'd be happy to help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much...
Now then, let us resume our hosting practice.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Here you are. I am delighted to see
that the tea suits your taste. Please let me know if you need anything else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Offering refills is the host's duty—
No issues there, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san, you also prepared the cake stand nicely.
However, there are just slightly
too many pastries on the plate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so sorry...! Desu ne!
I just wanted them to eat plenty, so I got carried away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the tea in the cup is half empty...
Shall I top it up?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
In times like that, you pour the remainder
into the slop bowl. And then you pour fresh tea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that they can always enjoy
warm, freshly poured tea!

And so, Tokai Teio and the others
continued hosting—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew! How was that, McQueen?!
I handled everything properly, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in terms of fulfilling the "role"
expected of you, there were no issues, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But honestly~, I've thought this since I was a kid,
having manners for every little thing gets exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We're just drinking tea, so why
do we need so many strict rules about this and that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...This is merely my personal philosophy, however...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The words we choose are meant to ensure
that our visiting guests spend a pleasant time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The minute rules exist to harmonize the atmosphere
and allow everyone to enjoy a comfortable moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Manners serve not only to 'refine oneself,'
but also carry the meaning of 'showing consideration
so that others may feel at ease,' desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even if Chiyono O-san is not yet accustomed
to every formal gesture, her heart was filled with genuine hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Certainly, as a young lady of a distinguished family,
Teio-san possesses knowledge of the motions, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Only when one is mindful of their meaning
do those manners reveal their true worth.

To thank them for the tea, I decided
to help clean up. However, Tokai Teio wore a bitter expression.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The meaning behind the manners, huh...
choice_data_list: It's tough, but there's a lot of depth to it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Just looking the part isn't enough.
A heart of hospitality, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
McQueen really is amazing...
Man, that's frustrating! Since it's so frustrating, I'll prove her wrong next time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna host my very own,
absolutely best tea party ever!
choice_data_list: What kind of tea party will it be?
What kind of tea party are you planning?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna host my very own,
absolutely best tea party ever!
choice_data_list: What kind of tea party will it be?
What kind of tea party are you planning?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's still a secret!
Look forward to the big day~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All righty, time to go pitch this to the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Geez,
what kind of troublemaker do you think I am?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, just look forward to the day.
Promise!
